categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and corrects schema defaults generated by getopenrpcinfo.
categories.rationale: Fixes schema validation errors where `getopenrpcinfo` emitted defaults that violated their declared types. According to the PR description, invalid prose was emitted for `getdeploymentinfo.blockhash` and a string instead of a boolean was set for `send.options.include_watching`.
